note: Rights classes are set by a human. The agent may only lower a class (e.g. on new restrictive evidence), never raise one to PUBLICATION_CLEARED. PUBLICATION_CLEARED requires clearance.cleared_by / cleared_on / evidence.

rights_classes.INTERNAL_PREVIEW_ONLY: Internal timing/pacing previews only. Never published, distributed or monetised.
rights_classes.PENDING_REVIEW: Not evaluated or not yet approved by a human. Not usable for publication.
rights_classes.PUBLICATION_CLEARED: A named human recorded that the output may be used in monetised YouTube videos.
